blocks.text: Explore Shillong to Cherrapunji Journey with Kajaawa Cabs

content.text: The ride of 1 hr 50 mins through the East Khasi Hills, from Shillong to Cherrapunji portrays nature at its best. The surroundings are sure to amaze you. The lush greenery over the mountains surrounds the highway. You will travel across the Highland with a stopover at the Mawkdok viewpoint

The twist and turns of the pathway will unreveal the beauty of the Khasi Hills, with gorgeous green valleys, and those dense layers of mist that will freshen you up. You’ll wish that this journey does not end. The quiet cantonment areas of Shillong will bring calmness to the soul. while the picturesque view of the landscape does not end.
On this journey, you will definitely be greeted by the warm smiles of the locals that are welcoming to all. Everything will be worth it.

One of the top tourist destinations in Cherrapunji. It is the fourth highest waterfall in the world and is often given the title ‘ dangerously beautiful. The majestic Nohkalikai Falls is named after a tragic local Khasi woman named Likai, who jumped off the cliff due to a tragic incident. While visiting this waterfall you can indulge in more activities such as trekking, camping, bird watching, and photography. The pride of Meghalaya will not fail to impress you.

This cave is an entryway to the adventure hidden underground. visiting this cave will give you a new kind of adventure but do watch out for the narrow pathways. There are lights installed in the cave to help you navigate your way. While making your way from the entrance to the cave don’t miss the stunning views of the valley nearby. The safety signs marked in the cave will help you avoid danger. The artificial light falls over the fossils of pre-historic creatures that are present on the walls of the cave

Located 10kms away from Cherrapunji, the Thangkharang Park is home to a number of species of plants. The scenic beauty of this place makes it a popular tourist destination. It is also a great picnic spot to spend quality time with your loved ones. The park is well maintained and has a greenhouse, two beautiful fountains, and amazing viewpoints that look over to the ‘pillar rocks’. A connecting bridge over the gushing stream will take you over to the other side of the park.

One of the major tourist attractions, Ka Khoh Ramhah also known as Basket of the Giant is a great viewpoint that looks over the plains of Bangladesh. You will be star-struck to witness that this pillared rock is bounded by two small rocks that are of the same shape. Isn’t it unbelievable? The stream that flows through the rocks enhances the beauty of this place, leaving everyone spellbound.

The best time to visit this waterfall is during the monsoons, the gushing sound of the waterfall gives calmness to the ear. This two-tiered waterfall will give you a stupendous view of the surrounding canyon and the vegetation in and around it. The monsoon season gives a new life to the place, witness the gush of water making its way through the huge boulders and vegetation. The mellifluous roar of the fall can be heard during that time.

Situated inside the Thangkharang Park, this is a three-tiered waterfall. This is India’s 7th highest waterfall that falls from a height of 305 mts. Amidst the park, the thundering roar of the waterfall can be heard. while moving closer to the waterfall you will experience light sprays of water coming down from the fall. the best time to enjoy this waterfall is during the monsoons.

One of the popular caves in Cherrapunji, the Arwah Cave that is known for the fossil and limestone formations in this huge cave.Though only a small part of the cave is open for tourism and archaeological enthusiasts. the cave has several chambers and narrow passages, that might need you to crawl over them.on average it will take you about 20 minutes to explore the cave. There is also a stream that flows through the cave. A complete package indeed.

Nongsawlia Presbyterian Church is the oldest church in Meghalaya and the first church in the North East. A great portion of history has been embedded in this church dating back to 1848. The early settlers and their struggle are well preserved in this place. People from all around the world come to visit this church. this is a nice place to interact with the locals. At the top of the hill lies a graveyard, from which the area of Nongsawlia can be seen.
From Shillong to Cherrapunjee, the travel time is 1 hour 55 minutes and 54.0 km via SH5 in a cab. You can stopover at the Mawkdok view point, which is a major attraction on the way to Cherrapunjee.
